messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [AUTOPAGE] PagerDuty P-4812 triggered — spike in 5xx for /v1/inference/generate (eu-west1). 5m 5xx rate: 18%. See <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-4812>
sam: ack — I'm on it, grabbing logs now. tagging @maria (oncall)
maria: oncall here, looking. any immediate customer-facing errors reported?
incident-bot: Top affected endpoints: /v1/inference/generate (90% of errors), /v1/embeddings/batch (7%). Error class: 502 upstream reset / short read. Traffic surge coincides with a canary roll at 12:02 UTC.
liam: I pushed a small rate-limit tweak during the canary at 12:04. rolling back if it's related. @sam can you tail the proxy/kvcache logs?
sam: tailing now — seeing repeated upstream resets to kvcache-proxy. snippet:
```
proxy: upstream 10.0.3.12:8080 reset by peer
502 response_count=312
```
jack: eng-runtime — noted. I'm disabling the canary in eu-west1 now: `infra/rollout cancel canary infer-v2 --region eu-west1` — will report when done.
maria: also temporarily reduce route weight to the canary: `rtctl set-weight infer-v2 0.2 --region eu-west1` and throttle new session creation for dedicated pools.
sam: after the rollback and weight change, eu-west1 5xx dropped to ~3% over the last 2m. continuing to watch.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-4812 acknowledged by sam. Auto-escalation set to eng-runtime in +5m if 5xx > 10%.
liam: confirming canary disabled. preliminary root cause appears to be connection churn at kernel level on the canary instances (gRPC long-lived streams). planning kernel param patch + redeploy of canary with lowered connection backlog.
maria: customer comms — @support-bot please create/update tickets for known impacted accounts (AcmeCorp, BetaGroup). Ops, prepare short postmortem stub and timeline.
support-bot: Created support ticket S-2042 for AcmeCorp with template "service-degradation". Notifying account owners.
ops-rotation: prepping postmortem stub and will collect logs/traces. recommend leaving this thread open until stable for 10m.
sam: :thumbsup: marking as monitoring — will update on 5m cadence. if 5xx stays <5% for 10m we start recovery checklist and close the PD incident.
